Thanks Soojin — appreciate the options. Quick flag: several of our stakeholders in NSW and VIC have raised concerns about Sunday/Monday Apr 4–5 because that weekend crosses our state DST changeover (clocks go back early Apr). We often see calendar confusion and missed invites around that date.

If possible, could we avoid any slots that fall exactly on Apr 4–5 local dates? Our preference would be:
- Tue Apr 6, any time AEST after 10:00 AM (which should be reasonable for your AM PT folks)

Attendees from our side: me (Sophie Turner), Paul Gibson (Head of Ops), and likely our Platform Engineer, Liam Kerr (I’ll confirm).

Sorry for the short notice — we just decided to avoid the DST weekend.

Best,

Soojin / Laura — forwarding Sophie’s note. They want to avoid Apr 4–5 due to NSW DST rollback. Can we shift to Apr 6?

For SE coverage I’m available Apr 6 9:00–11:00 PT (which would be Apr 7 early hours AEST) — but that still looks like late night for them. Better match: Apr 6 11:00 AM AEST corresponds to Apr 5 5:00 PM PT. I can do Apr 5 5:00 PM PT (evening for us) if we want a more reasonable local time for their team.

If Laura / Soojin prefer, I can also do a 7:00 AM PT slot (which is 11:00 PM AEST same day) but that’s pushing it for their devs.

Also, quick ops note: when we send calendar-invite.ics include explicit timezone tokens (TZID=Australia/Sydney) and a Zoom link — they tend to rely on local ICS imports.

Marcus

I’ve attached the updated deck and included a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) with explicit TZID entries to avoid the DST ambiguity. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: SRdemo123).

Can you confirm attendees and I’ll finalize the invite?

Cheers,
Soojin
